title: Cyclone heading for the Andhra coast
lede: A low-pressure system in the Bay of Bengal is set to cross the Andhra coast. If it strengthens into a cyclone, it gets the name Arnab. Here's the track so far.
india: East Telangana gets heavy rain on Oct 28; Hyderabad gets moderate rain. Travel to Khammam, Kothagudem, Vizag or coastal Andhra could be hit.

players.name: IMD
players.role: Tracks the storm, issues district alerts.

players.name: Andhra Pradesh
players.role: Evacuating low-lying areas from Bapatla to Vizianagaram.

players.name: Telangana
players.role: Red alert for Mulugu, Kothagudem, Khammam on Oct 28.

timeline.what: Forecasters say the east coast may soon see the year's first cyclone.
Low pressure forms; IMD red alert for 3 Telangana districts on Oct 28.
Crossing point shifts south to Machilipatnam–Visakhapatnam, evening of Oct 27. 16 Telangana districts on alert; Andhra starts evacuations.
The system becomes a depression; expected to strengthen into a cyclone by Oct 27.
IMD: landfall Bapatla–Visakhapatnam Oct 28, gusts to 140 kmph; Telangana red alert Oct 29 for Mulugu, Kothagudem, Khammam, Mahabubabad
